code: const STORAGE_KEY='psyqa_response_times_v1';const MAX_SAMPLES=20;const DEFAULT_ESTIMATE_SEC=18;export function recordResponseTimeMs(ms){if(typeof window==='undefined'||ms<500||ms>300000)return;try{const prev=JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||'[]');const next=[...prev,ms].slice(-MAX_SAMPLES);window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(next));}catch{/* ignore */}}export function getEstimatedWaitSec(){if(typeof window==='undefined')return DEFAULT_ESTIMATE_SEC;try{const samples=JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||'[]');if(!samples.length)return DEFAULT_ESTIMATE_SEC;const avgMs=samples.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/samples.length;return Math.max(8,Math.min(90,Math.round(avgMs/1000)));}catch{return DEFAULT_ESTIMATE_SEC;}}
